about.title: Nice to meet you, I am Dr. Guilherme Carvalho
about.p1: I am a physiotherapist dedicated to treating people living with back pain, herniated discs, sciatic nerve pain and other musculoskeletal conditions.
about.p2: I believe every patient deserves individualized care. That is why every appointment begins with a detailed assessment to understand the source of the pain and define the best approaches for each case.
about.p3: More than relieving symptoms, my goal is to help you recover your movement, your confidence and your quality of life.

conditions.title: Where does it hurt?
conditions.subtitle: Pick the area. I'll show what's usually behind it and how treatment starts.

cervical.label: Neck
cervical.feels: I wake up stiff, and turning my neck to back the car out has become a problem.
cervical.does: The assessment tests mobility and pinpoints which cervical segment locked up. Adjustment and release start in the same session, with exercises so it doesn't come back.
cervical.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is neck pain and I'd like to book an assessment.

ombro.label: Shoulder
ombro.feels: I can't raise my arm to reach a shelf, and sleeping on that side is impossible.
ombro.does: We test the joint and rotator cuff to separate tendinitis, impingement and pain referred from the neck. Treatment changes with the finding.
ombro.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is shoulder pain and I'd like to book an assessment.

escapulas.label: Between shoulder blades
escapulas.feels: That stab in the middle of my back after hours at the computer.
escapulas.does: It's almost always a locked thoracic spine plus rounded shoulders. We treat the spine and retrain your everyday posture — not just release the sore spot.
escapulas.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is pain between the shoulder blades and I'd like to book an assessment.

lombar.label: Lower back
lombar.feels: It hurts to put my shoes on, and sitting for long has become punishment.
lombar.does: Physical exam and movement tests point to which structure is generating the pain. You don't need to arrive knowing what it is — working that out is what the assessment is for.
lombar.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is low back pain and I'd like to book an assessment.

hernia.label: Disc herniation
hernia.feels: The scan showed a herniation, and the first word I heard was surgery.
hernia.diagram: Under load, the disc's nucleus escapes backwards and presses on the nerve root. That's where the pain running down comes from.
hernia.does: A herniation on an MRI isn't always the one causing pain — plenty of people have one on imaging with no symptoms at all. The assessment confirms whether the disc is actually the source before any conclusion. Surgery is the exception, not the starting point.
hernia.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. I have a disc herniation and I'd like to book an assessment.

quadril.label: Hip
quadril.feels: It hurts getting up from a chair and climbing stairs. I avoid squatting now.
quadril.does: We assess hip, lower back and how you load the body when walking. A lot of hip pain starts with a pelvis that doesn't move properly.
quadril.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is hip pain and I'd like to book an assessment.

ciatico.label: Down the leg
ciatico.feels: The pain leaves my lower back and runs down my leg. Sometimes it tingles to the foot.
ciatico.does: Pain that travels down is almost always a nerve root compressed up in the lower back. We treat where the cause is, not where you feel it — and measure progress at every reassessment.
ciatico.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. My complaint is pain running down my leg and I'd like to book an assessment.

atletas.label: Training
atletas.feels: I train hard, but my body can't keep up anymore — something's always locked up.
atletas.does: Maintenance between sessions: mobility, release and adjustments so you perform without getting injured. The plan is built around your training schedule.
atletas.message: Hi, Dr. Guilherme! I came from the Chiropractic page. I train and I'd like to book a maintenance assessment.

neural.text: Specific movements that free nerve gliding — essential for sciatica and tingling.

faq.title: Common questions about chiropractic care
faq.a1: No. Techniques are applied precisely and within each patient's comfort limit. Some people feel mild soreness after the session, which fades within hours.
faq.a2: Yes. Performed by a licensed physiotherapist after a thorough assessment, chiropractic care is safe, with indications and contraindications respected case by case.
faq.a3: Adults of all ages — from athletes to seniors. The initial assessment rules out contraindications and defines the best technique for you.
faq.q4: How long does a visit take?
faq.a4: On average 50 minutes to 1 hour, including assessment and treatment at the first session.
faq.q5: How many sessions are usually needed?
faq.a5: It depends on the case. Acute conditions often respond within a few sessions; chronic ones need a slightly longer plan. You get a clear estimate at the assessment.
faq.a6: Yes. Disc herniation is one of the most frequent conditions at the clinic, treated with manual therapy, neural mobilization and specific exercises.
faq.a7: Yes. Sciatic pain responds very well to the combination of chiropractic, neural mobilization and dry needling, depending on the source found at the assessment.
faq.a8: Care is private, which guarantees one-on-one sessions fully dedicated to your case. We provide receipts for reimbursement with your insurance plan.
faq.q9: How much does the visit cost?
faq.a9: The price is shared on WhatsApp based on your assessment. We split payment on card and provide receipts for health-insurance reimbursement.
